prompt: We're redesigning our B2B analytics dashboard and want it to feel modern but professional -- not too playful, not too corporate. Help me find the right visual direction through references.

assertions.text: Gathers references specifically for B2B analytics dashboards
Filters for the 'modern but professional' aesthetic, excluding playful and overly corporate
Identifies patterns in data visualization, layout, typography, and color usage
Compares different visual approaches (dark vs light, card-based vs data-dense)
Produces a curated reference collection that defines the visual direction
